rows.summary: Word follows Design → Spacing (margins, Line Height, Between Sections/Items, Spacing Override; 21d64d1) and now Section Options → Title (0b708c8) and Grids (0cd1767), as the PDF lays them out.

Fixed by d92c1ec (R2-063): entry text prints in the Text colour's shades and skill categories in the Text colour (the accent only on Modern and in Tags/Bars). 69-word-text-colour fails 9 of 9 on the code before d92c1ec.
Duplicate of R2-062, fixed by 21d64d1: Word takes the margins, Line Height and section/item gaps of Design → Spacing.

Spacing and Spacing Override were fixed by 21d64d1. An entry's header now follows Title (Stacked, Inline or Side by side) as ItemHeader. Grids print as a borderless fixed table with cells at the PDF's 48/31/23 % (equal cells over 4); Languages and References are 2 across when unset; the Sidebar's side column stays 1; dates sit at the cell's right edge. Stacked skills print the category on its own line over a thin rule (the side column prints one skill per line).
Fixed by 21d64d1: the dates' right tab is the paper width minus both Left/Right margins (wordContentTwips), tested on A4 and US Letter at 18, 35 and 0 mm; in a grid it is the cell's width.
Duplicate of R2-114 (the hard-coded 9000-twip tab), fixed by 21d64d1.
Duplicate of R2-114 (the hard-coded 9000-twip tab), fixed by 21d64d1.
Descriptions and bullets print at Entry Header (half a point under it except a job's); the second field, location and dates print at Base, as the PDF; the Sidebar page's cards use their own sizes.
Entry text follows Entry Header as in the PDF (6d802b9); the contact line follows Base since 4203257 (R2-067).

Word prints the photo where the PDF does: the PDF's box, a Circle as an ellipse, Rounded/Square with the PDF's corners, cropped to fill the box, and the Thin/Accent ring as an outline. It sits beside the name in a borderless table row (Photo ↔ Text, Text Position), or above the name in a centred header and on the Sidebar. A hidden or undrawable photo prints nothing; a WebP's printable copy and a plain URL's picture print too.
rows.remaining: An SVG photo prints nothing in Word: Word needs a raster copy, and the export can't make one.

rows.summary: Minimal's light name prints regular in the Word résumé, as in its PDF and Word letter; every other template's name stays bold.

issues: A stored photo with a stray character in its base64 made the Word export throw (strict atob).
Word printed no photo for a plain https URL (JSON Resume image) or a pre-conversion WebP/GIF, which the PDF prints.
A stored Grids over 4 printed as one column in Word; the PDF prints equal cells side by side.
Not fixed, outside the rows: Executive's and Academic's PDFs print an entry's second field and location in italic, and Inline joins with ', '; Word prints them upright with ' — ' (as on the base).

notes: Existing test assertions changed, each justified by a row: 04-word-export, 10-section-options, 10-section-alignment-word, 26-dates and 29-date-format (R2-070 Stacked title); 35-word-skill-category-case (R2-070 Stacked skills); 46-header-photo-text-gap (R2-126: it pinned 'Word prints no photo'); 69-word-spacing (6d802b9, the Sidebar job's own size). 7a751d5 (the stopped agent's wip) was reverted by 3d51158 and re-landed as 0b708c8 and 0cd1767. contactRows (wordExportContacts.js, shared with the letter) takes an optional width; the letter doesn't pass one, so it is unchanged. Grids and the photo print as borderless tables in the .docx. Checked in LibreOffice 24.2.
